root_cause.mechanism: Cold constructor writes portFC then uses SP4000/PUSH to fill a16KiB world bank at0000..3FFF. On fixed RAM FC writes do not select another bank, overwriting live Page0 code. Runtime world helpers also assume Page0 bank selection, so removing only that constructor is insufficient.
root_cause.scope: Read-only breakpoints around the first real cold map construction on the exact supported ROM. No code/state/payload injection.
